Introduction

Kim Kibum, known better as his stage name Key, is a member of the South Korean boy group SHINee under SM Entertainment. He was also a member of the short lived duo Toheart with Infinite's Woohyun.

Key made his official debut as a member of SHINee on May 22, 2008 with the group's first mini album "Replay". He later made his solo debut with the digital single "Forever Yours" on November 6, 2018.

Well known for his love of fashion, he helped design many of SHINee's costumes worn in concerts.
